name: Ethical and Responsible Management
description:
1.Ethical principles in business: Utility, Rights, Justice, Care and Virtues. Ethical relativism
2. Social Role of Business: Corporate Social Responsibility and Corporate Governance. (Background case for Reading Microsoft 
3. Ethics of Business Systems and Ethics in the Marketplace: Perfect Competition, Monopoly and Oligopoly
4. Environment: Dimensions of pollution and depletion, pollution control and conservation of resources
Case for Discussion: Sterlite Copper: Business at what cost?
5. The ethics of consumer production and marketing: Consumer protection, Business firm's duties to consumers (Contract view), Due care theory, Manufacturer's duties (Social cost view), Advertising ethics, Consumer Privacy
6. Ethics of HRM - Job discrimination, Political organization, Caring organization
7. Factors Impacting Ethical Behaviour: Whistleblowing, ethical culture, leadership, codes etc.
